name: EMEET PIXY
author: eduardo (fork of nille/omarchy-emeet-pixy)
description: EMEET PIXY webcam control: privacy, AI tracking, pan/tilt/zoom, microphone, image settings, framing presets, snapshots, and the camera's own firmware settings.

barWidget.description: Close the lens, mute the mic, switch AI tracking on or off, aim the camera, adjust the picture, recall framing presets, take a snapshot, and set the camera's own firmware options.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read camera state while the panel is open.

schema.label: Pan/tilt step (degrees)
schema.description: How far one arrow press on the jog pad moves the camera.

schema.label: Hide when no camera found
schema.description: Remove the bar icon entirely when the camera is unplugged, instead of showing a dimmed one.

schema.label: Show video preview
schema.description: Show a small live preview while the panel is open. Only one app can capture at a time, so the preview yields automatically to any app already using the camera. Turn it off to keep the camera free for other apps entirely. The switch pinned above the panel's preview sets this same value, so either place works.

schema.label: Open the lens when a call starts
schema.description: Uncover the camera as soon as another app starts using it, and close it again when that app lets go. A call is any app holding the video stream, so this needs no list of meeting apps. Only reverses what it changed: a lens that was already open is left open.

schema.label: Remember Standard/Tracking
schema.description: Keep the last mode you picked and put the camera back in it whenever an app is using it, undoing any change made behind the panel's back. The camera only accepts the switch while something holds the stream, so the first couple of seconds of a call can still be in the old mode.

schema.label: Keep the framing
schema.description: The camera recenters pan and tilt every time it opens its lens, and Tracking moves it too, while the panel keeps showing the old angles. With this on, the angles the panel shows are written back whenever the lens opens or Tracking hands over to Standard, so the camera points where the panel says. It takes a couple of seconds into a call to notice, so the camera starts centered and then moves.

schema.label: Unmute the microphone when a call starts
schema.description: Unmute the camera's own microphone when a call starts, and mute it again afterwards — but only if it was muted to begin with, so a mic deliberately left on is never muted for you.
